items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: "See that little girl sitting right there? She said, 'Come on, Tina, let's go.'"

ctx.x: See that little girl sitting right there? She said, "Come on, Tina, let's go." Those were her last words -- "Come on, Keemer, let's go."
You don't remember the date I found you.
